"You are a helpful language assistant.

One person was in charge of pointing out instructions, and the other was in charge of permute instructions. The permute instructions had three subunits for simple integer, complex integer, and floating-point instructions. These units had pipelines of varying lengths: 10 stages for simple integer and permute instructions, 13 stages for complex integer instructions, and 16 stages for floating-point instructions.

Carlos Fonseca explained that the original document had been lost, so they decided to look for the one that was closest to the sequence taken a second before or after the other to replace it. He said, 'It was almost the same, only in this one I had a lost look.'

In music, an artist released a hit album with three types of songs: an uptempo banger, 'I'ma Do It', and a heartfelt ballad, 'Just Call My Name'. The following year, she released dual singles, 'Forever My Love' and 'True Love' to coincide with her debut single anniversary. In February, she co-headlined a concert.

In the field of rhetoric, the method recommended by writers such as Erasmus in 'De copia' and 'De ratio studii' was to make notes on whatever they were reading, categorized by theme. They would cart these commonplaces in boxes that accompanied them. When assembling a new book, they would go through the topics and cross out commonplace notes as they used them."
